title: Prosary offline Bible passages
description: Canonical build-time-resolved Bible passages. readings-texts.json includes passages; readings-editions.json omits them for lightweight metadata loading. Exact licensed Mass text is not represented by this format.

wholeVersePassages.description: Exact passage keys whose partial-verse appointments or reviewed numbering correspondences require enclosing whole verses. Missing means empty. Clients retain the original citation and show a localized full-verse notice for these keys. If any edition requires a wider whole-verse envelope, the key is listed for all editions. Only keys present in passages are listed.

languageCode.description: Controls chapter heading language and numerals independently of interface language. Hebrew uses gematria; Arabic Eastern Arabic digits; Aramaic follows the actual selected paired script; Greek el uses Κεφάλαιο with decimal numbers. Chapter numbers are never italicized.

textScript.description: Script of each verse's primary text; paired editions declare both script fields.

transliteratedTextScript.description: Script of each verse's paired transliteratedText. For Peshitta this is the unchanged Syriac source, matching the existing Aramaic prayer contract.

endVerse.description: Optional inclusive last label of an indivisible printed verse unit. Must be greater than or equal to verse and below the next unit's start. Display a range and let jumps within it resolve to this single unit; never split or duplicate its text.

transliteratedText.description: Paired script of the same complete verse, never another translation. Required in every verse of an edition declaring paired scripts; readers reject an incomplete pair.

letterIndex.description: One-based Hebrew letter index within the exact anchor; count U+05D0–U+05EA, not code units or combining marks.

retainedVowels.description: Preserve one independently readable companion vowel while omitting the unreadable point; actual vowel code points must exactly match this list.

sourceNote.description: An unreadable Hebrew point omitted from the primary text and visibly disclosed. Validate the anchored occurrence, absence of the target mark, source pages, HTTPS without credentials, and book-wide unique IDs. See SCRIPTURE-SOURCE-NOTES.markdown.
